product_architecture.pattern: CLI-first Layered Pipeline with Tier-Gated Capability Unlock

orchestration_layer.evidence: pipeline.py STAGE_ORDER list, config.py:184-259 tier system

domain_engines.evidence: 各模块独立 pipeline._run_* 调用

infrastructure_layer.evidence: database.py ThreadPoolExecutor 连接池，config.py:1-180 配置加载链

data_flow.mechanism: SQLite jobs.db as conveyor belt between stages

pipeline_stages.name: score
pipeline_stages.input_filter: jobs.description IS NOT NULL AND jobs.score IS NULL

pipeline_stages.name: tailor
pipeline_stages.input_filter: jobs.score >= min_score AND jobs.tailored_resume_path IS NULL
pipeline_stages.evidence: pipeline.py:286 tailor PENDING_SQL with score filter

pipeline_stages.name: cover
pipeline_stages.input_filter: jobs.tailored_resume_path IS NOT NULL AND jobs.cover_letter_path IS NULL

data_flow.streaming_mode: Each stage polls SQLite PENDING_SQL independently, no explicit message queue
data_flow.apply_flow: apply/launcher.py reads jobs WHERE tailored_resume_path IS NOT NULL AND applied_at IS NULL → worker loop → Chrome subprocess + claude CLI with MCP config

tiers.label: AI Scoring & Tailoring
tiers.unlock_conditions: Tier 1 + LLM API key env var (GEMINI_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY / LLM_URL)
tiers.evidence: config.py:223 return 2 when has_llm=true but !(has_claude AND has_chrome)
tiers.notes: cli.py:118-121 run command checks Tier 2 before score/tailor/cover stages

tiers.label: Full Auto-Apply
tiers.notes: cli.py:189-190 apply command triple gate: Tier 3 + profile exists + DB has tailored resumes

hidden_behaviors.name: dry_run tier override
hidden_behaviors.evidence: cli.py dry_run flag causes pipeline.run_pipeline() to return early without actual stage execution, bypassing Tier gates
hidden_behaviors.impact: Tier 1 users can preview full pipeline behavior with 'run all --dry-run'

src/applypilot/cli.py.responsibility: Entry point, all 6 CLI commands, Tier gate enforcement, apply triple validation

src/applypilot/pipeline.py.responsibility: Stage orchestration (sequential + streaming), PENDING_SQL definitions, error continuation logic

src/applypilot/config.py.responsibility: AppConfig dataclass hierarchy, Tier detection algorithm, dependency check

src/applypilot/database.py.responsibility: SQLite singleton, jobs table CRUD, per-thread connection pool, statistics aggregation

src/applypilot/llm.py.responsibility: Multi-provider LLM client (Gemini / OpenAI / Anthropic), prompt building, retry logic

src/applypilot/wizard/init.py.responsibility: 5-step interactive profile wizard (resume → personal → search → AI → auto-apply)

src/applypilot/discovery/.responsibility: JobSpy + Workday CXS + SmartExtract three-source discovery

src/applypilot/scoring/.responsibility: Fit scoring (prompt-based), resume tailoring (self-critique loop), validation, cover letter generation

src/applypilot/apply/launcher.py.responsibility: Auto-apply worker loop, Chrome subprocess spawn, MCP config assembly, Ctrl+C double-interrupt, result classification

src/applypilot/apply/chrome.py.responsibility: Chrome binary launch with isolated profile dir, CDP port management

src/applypilot/apply/prompt.py.responsibility: Claude Agent system prompt construction from profile + job + rules

src/applypilot/config/sites.yaml.responsibility: Blocked SSO domains list, Workday site templates, selector mappings

risk_register.title: Dual database access patterns
risk_register.description: Discovery modules use direct sqlite3.connect() while other layers use JobsDB class. Potential connection/pooling inconsistency.
risk_register.recommendation: Unify all DB access through JobsDB class; add connection pool to sqlite3 path

risk_register.title: Workday CXS API instability
risk_register.description: Workday scraper relies on undocumented JSON API endpoints. Workday may change response format without notice.
risk_register.recommendation: Add response schema validation + graceful degradation to SmartExtract fallback

risk_register.title: Stage failure isolation relies on try/except continuation
risk_register.description: pipeline.py catches Exception per stage and continues. If discover fails silent, enrich runs against empty DB (no data to process).
risk_register.evidence: pipeline.py _run_discover() has try/except; _PENDING_SQL will return 0 rows → next stages no-op
risk_register.recommendation: Add explicit stage completion signal + alert if zero records processed after a stage

risk_register.title: API keys in .env file without encryption
risk_register.description: LLM API keys stored in plaintext ~/.applypilot/.env. No encryption at rest.
risk_register.evidence: config.py load_env() calls python-dotenv load_dotenv() which reads plaintext .env
risk_register.recommendation: Use OS credential manager (keyring) or encrypted config with optional master password

risk_register.title: Auto-apply depends on Claude Code CLI external process
risk_register.description: Tier 3 launcher spawns subprocess.run(['claude', ...]). Claude Code CLI behavior updates independently of ApplyPilot.
risk_register.recommendation: Pin known-good claude CLI version; add capability probe that validates claude --version matches expected

risk_register.title: Streaming mode relies on SQLite polling (no real message queue)
risk_register.description: Upstream stages write to DB, downstream stages poll PENDING_SQL. No real-time notification. Latency depends on poll interval.
risk_register.evidence: pipeline.py streaming mode iterates stages and re-checks DB count
risk_register.recommendation: Consider SQLite WAL mode + notification triggers, or Redis/Kafka for real-time notification

risk_register.title: No streaming within discover stage itself
risk_register.description: JOURNEY-0005 (--streaming) polls discover completion but discover internally runs JobSpy → Workday → SmartExtract sequentially.
risk_register.evidence: pipeline.py _run_discover() sequential calls; _UPSTREAM does not split discover
risk_register.recommendation: Optionally parallelize discover sources with asyncio/ThreadPoolExecutor

risk_register.title: apply --gen --url accidentally Tier-gated
risk_register.description: cli.py:189 check_tier(3) runs before gen mode check at cli.py:213. Tier 2 users cannot use --gen --url for debugging.
risk_register.evidence: cli.py line order: check_tier(3) at 190, gen check at 213
risk_register.recommendation: Move gen/url utility mode checks before Tier 3 gate; add custom tier for debug mode (or no tier)

what_applypilot_differentiates: Single-binary CLI with capability tiers (most competitors are web apps or SaaS)
SQLite-based pipeline with streaming parallelism (unique conveyor-belt design)
Claude Code Agent with Playwright MCP for auto-apply (not Playwright direct)
Workday CXS + SmartExtract dual-source strategy (most use single source)
what_may_limit_scale: SQLite bottleneck for multi-user scenarios (single user DB design)
Depends on external LLM provider + Claude Code CLI (dual vendor lock-in)
No web UI (rich terminal only, no non-technical user path)
